the conceptual metaphor THEORIES ARE BUILDINGS is a metaphorical conceptualization of a domain that is not primarily conceptualized in terms of building, and that it is not a metaphorical conceptualizing of a domain that has a primary metaphorical conceptualization in terms of building.

(i) there are two different kinds of metaphor, linguistic and conceptual; (ii) the two kinds of metaphor are not isomorphic; and (iii) the two kinds are related, but the relation between them is complex.

1) The conceptual metaphors of anger are based on a conceptual domain that includes anger as one of its subdomains; 2) The subdomains of the conceptual domain are organized into a conceptual network; 3) The subdomains are connected to each other by conceptual relations that are based on conceptual metaphors; 4) The conceptual metaphoric relations between the subdomains are not symmetrical.
